name: ICM-42688-P 6-axis IMU (accel/gyro)

procurement.note: User pick 2026-09-12, replaces MPU-9250 (OSP-IC-0003, EOL). OPN registration in flight via PLM. Pair with mmc5983ma for mag.

physical.mass_note: TDK product center weight field; CAD to sanity-check against reel/unit convention

orientation.die_frame: single die frame for accel+gyro; axes per DS-000347 fig 16 (orientation of axes of sensitivity)
orientation.note: No in-package mag die - mag is the separate mmc5983ma part; no mag remap needed in the estimator

ee.footprint_note: LGA-14 2.5x3.0x0.91mm pitch 0.5mm - EE to create/select during SB2 re-spin

design_notes: Gyro spike-artefact quirk: documented on flight controllers (Betaflight #12970); firmware mitigation pattern exists. ArduPilot observed events severe enough to force in-flight IMU lane switches.
Wants a clean low-noise 3.3V rail - layout/decoupling care on the TPS62132 rail (design note, not a blocker).
External clock input (31-50kHz) available to reduce ODR sensitivity to temperature.

gyro.provenance: noise density: DS-000347 typ 2.8 mdps/rtHz; ZRO/tempco: datasheet; bias walk: TUNABLE carried from mpu9250 model pending characterization

accel.provenance: noise density: DS-000347 typ 65-70 ug/rtHz (70 used); tempco: datasheet; bias walk: TUNABLE carried
